connector.name: Transloadit Media Processing
connector.registryDescription: Process video, audio, images, and documents with 86+ cloud media processing robots.
connector.summary: Hosted at api2.transloadit.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the transloadit account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token obtained via the authenticate tool, or set TRANSLOADIT_KEY and TRANSLOADIT_SECRET env vars with the self-hosted package instead
